dependencies.title: Asymptotic properties of infinite directed unions of local quadratic transforms
dependencies.role: Separate stronger lead; no mathematical result accepted by proxy and no proof dependency.

Polynomial rings over fields and their localizations are UFDs; localization at the ideal of independent variables is regular local of the stated dimension; irreducibles in a UFD are prime. The lexicographic valuation construction, exact transforms, denominator normalization, fixed almost-integrality witness, complete closure, and nonvaluation obstruction are proved in full.

limitations: This is a prior negative resolution of the original unrestricted universal question, not a new theorem or priority claim.
The explicit starting ring is k[x,y,z]_(x,y,z), with its own fraction field k(x,y,z), over any field k.
The determining valuation is rank three with lexicographic value group Z^3; no rank-one valuation extension is accepted.
The union is nonarchimedean; no archimedean counterexample is accepted.
No independent certification of every general theorem or arbitrary-ring instance in the source paper is claimed.
The separate stronger example in arXiv:1509.07545 is excluded and not accepted by proxy.
Journal of Algebra 474 (2017), 213–239 is metadata-verified; the final journal PDF was not inspected and arXiv/journal text or byte identity is not claimed.
arXiv v3 was submitted 2016-10-01; the retrieved PDF internal typesetting date is 2021-10-28. These differ from the 2017 journal publication year.
Shannon 1973 Example 4.7 receives antecedent credit through Example 7.2 and reference [35]; the Shannon original was not independently inspected.
No external human peer review or formal proof-assistant certification is claimed. Finite diagnostics are supplementary, not a proof of universal mathematical statements.
